This '''mission''' was undertaken by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Neebo/Legends|Neebo]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]]. Neebo went missing during the mission and her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was later found in the lair of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
